python3 -c '
import json, os, fcntl, subprocess

OUT_DIR = "/opt/weather-pipeline/repo/data/icon_front_very_far"
manifest = json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "manifest.json")))
keep = set()
for s in manifest["snapshots"]:
    keep.update(s["files"].values())
keep.add("manifest.json")
keep.add("latest_log.txt")

removed = []
for fn in os.listdir(OUT_DIR):
    if fn not in keep:
        os.remove(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, fn))
        removed.append(fn)

print("removed:", removed)

lock = open("/tmp/vps_git.lock", "w")
fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
try:
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", "/opt/weather-pipeline/repo", "add", "-A", "data/icon_front_very_far/"], check=True)
    r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", "/opt/weather-pipeline/repo", "commit", "-m", "icon_front_very_far: cleanup orphaned PNGs not referenced by manifest"])
    if r.returncode == 0:
        subprocess.run(["git", "-C", "/opt/weather-pipeline/repo", "push", "origin", "main"], check=True)
        print("pushed cleanup")
    else:
        print("nothing to commit")
finally:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
'
